hypothesis: A probability blend restricted to the user-supplied potato crop can retain the original model's master validation while recovering the independent field-training gains.
selection: Pick the strongest paired mean field macro-F1 among fractions meeting both seeds' master limits and mean gains from the parent plan. Evaluate the same fractions for the class-count-matched control. Differences must be positive at both seeds. Use the lower fraction for ties. Choose the better field seed for the frozen candidate and the matching control seed.

automatic_ensemble.hypothesis: Equal probabilities averaged across the two matched, independently scratch-trained 224px CNNs may improve all-label macro-F1.
automatic_ensemble.test_scope: Okara supports three potato labels. It cannot validate the automatic ensemble across all 177 labels, so the broad result is validation-only.
